## Conference on Recent Advances in Materials and Manufacturing Processes

News Date : 13 Feb 2024News ReportMGIT in association with the Indian Institute of Technology, Hyderabad, University of Hyderabad, and Indian Institute of Metals (Hyderabad Chapter) organized a One-Day Conference on Recent Advances in Materials and Manufacturing Processes on 13.02.2024 (Tuesday) in the premises of the Institute. The Chief Guest of the Conference Professor B S Murty, Director, IIT Hyderabad has inaugurated the Conference and delivered keynote address. Dr. Muthukumaran, Mishra Dhatu Nigam Limited, Hyderabad and Dr. Komal Kapoor, CEO, NFC have graced the occasion as Guests of Honor. Professor G ChandraMohan Reddy, Principal, MGIT welcomed all the dignitaries, invitees and students to the conference. He suggested the students and researchers to take advantage of the outcome of the conference and progress in their careers. In his inaugural address, Professor B S Murty advised all the students to be ambitious to reach their goals and withstand the hurdles that come on their way. Dr. Muthukumaran and Dr. Komal Kapoor have suggested the students to take up challenges in their life and fulfill their dreams. The Conference witnessed several teachers, researchers, scientists and engineers from various Educational Institutions and organizations delivering talks on the newer developments in the field of materials engineering and recent advances in the stream of manufacturing technologies. The students, researchers and faculty members who have attended the conference have expressed that these kinds of events will pave way for progress in their careers. The conference ended with thanking all the guests, invitees, and all the resource persons.
